notes.title: From Hel To Asgard: Gameplay Preview
notes.content: [p]From Hel to Asgard is a merge-puzzle roguelite set against the backdrop of Norse mythology, releasing in 2026. The game is currently in active development. In this broadcast, made exclusively for Game Devs of Color Expo, we're showcasing some of the core features and gameplay we are currently working on with game writer Edwin Safari. [/p]
